title: Tutorials
summary: Build a concrete result with step-by-step lessons, editable examples and exercises.

blocks.text: Start with your first scene and video, build a practical project, or extend the engine. The time estimates describe a first pass through each lesson; allow extra time for experiments.

Begin with [Getting started](/getting-started) and follow the guides in order using Previous and Next. Each tutorial’s prerequisites link directly to the background material. The API provides exact contracts, and [focused examples](/focused-examples) isolate one scene feature at a time.
